patches.notes:
What's new:
• Leader card backs: rep your favourite Leader with 30 new animated full-art card backs (Customize > Leader card back)
• Lightning damage now strikes with real lightning
• Sealed and Draft: choose the table size, fill empty seats with AI at the difficulty you pick (local and online), and play Swiss rounds to a winner
• Online Draft picks look like local Draft, and online Sealed opens your packs first
• New "each opponent chooses" effects; picking your own cards now glows them on the board, then you confirm with the card shown
• Quick Match is now a "half Leader HP" option in Match Setup and online
• Nemesis fixes: The Blight King no longer joins its own deck, full match History, nicer ally fields with HP
• Phones: drag or hold to scroll, pinch to zoom, long-press for tooltips, and zoom and drag on every board
...and more.
